project: Project Rahul — Family 2D Pixel-Art Fighting Game

animations.gameplay_purpose: High/mid standing defensive block stance absorbing incoming standing and jumping attacks.
animations.starting_pose_notes: F1: Braced standing X-guard with thick muscular forearms crossed across chest/jawline, sunglasses clearly visible above wrists, knees solidly bent.
animations.ending_pose_notes: F4: Settles back smoothly into F1 crossed-forearm block for seamless looping.
animations.cross_batch_transition_notes: Connects cleanly to and from Batch 1 Standing Idle F1 (228 px height) and leads directly into Guard-Break F1 if guard meter depletes.

animations.gameplay_purpose: Low defensive block stance protecting against crouching attacks and sweeps.
animations.starting_pose_notes: F1: Low crouching X-guard matching Batch 1 Crouch Idle height (~189 px) with forearms braced across chest.
animations.ending_pose_notes: F4: Maintains crossed-forearm low block to loop seamlessly back into F1.
animations.cross_batch_transition_notes: Matches Batch 1 Crouch Idle and Batch 2 crouching attacks in exact height (183–190 px) and grounded stance.

animations.gameplay_purpose: Short hitstun reaction when struck by light jabs, quick pokes, or low-hitstun attacks from the right.
animations.starting_pose_notes: F1: Immediate upper-body jolt on contact with feet planted.
animations.ending_pose_notes: F3: Rapid stabilization back into upright standing fighting guard after F2 head/shoulder leftward recoil.
animations.cross_batch_transition_notes: Recovers cleanly into Batch 1 Standing Idle F1 or Standing Guard F1.

animations.gameplay_purpose: Extended grounded hitstun reaction for heavy punches, heavy kicks, and high-impact strikes.
animations.starting_pose_notes: F1: Violent impact head snap backward to the left as chest absorbs heavy force.
animations.ending_pose_notes: F5: Recovers into a slightly winded, weakened standing fighting stance following F2–F4 arm blow-open and stumble.
animations.cross_batch_transition_notes: Clearly distinct from Light Hit; F5 transitions smoothly into Batch 1 Standing Idle F1 or Guard.

pivot_and_ground_anchor.notes: F1 grounded impact; F2–F5 fully airborne involuntary knockback toward the left (head left, feet right).

animations.gameplay_purpose: Involuntary airborne juggle/blowback state triggered by anti-air uppercuts, launchers, sweeps, or heavy blowback specials.
animations.starting_pose_notes: F1: Grounded heavy impact jolt before feet leave the ground on F2.
animations.ending_pose_notes: F5: Back-first airborne descent (bottom_y=230, head LEFT, feet RIGHT) positioned to hand off directly into Knockdown F1.
animations.cross_batch_transition_notes: F5 connects seamlessly into Knockdown / Falling F1 (identical bottom_y=230 and head-left/feet-right orientation).

pivot_and_ground_anchor.notes: F1–F4 airborne descent toward floor; F5 ground slam impact at Y=272; F6 stable supine knocked-down pose (240 px wide, head LEFT, feet RIGHT).

animations.gameplay_purpose: Complete falling descent, floor impact slam, and knocked-down ground state.
animations.starting_pose_notes: F1: Continues back-first airborne descent directly from Launch / Knockback F5.
animations.ending_pose_notes: F6: Stable supine lying-down knocked-down pose resting flat on Y=272 (240 px wide, head LEFT, feet RIGHT).
animations.cross_batch_transition_notes: Receives Launch / Knockback F5; F6 matches Get-Up F1 in exact 240 px horizontal footprint, orientation, and ground baseline (and establishes reference footprint for future Batch 5 KO).

animations.gameplay_purpose: Wake-up recovery sequence transitioning Rahul from knocked-down supine state back to active standing combat.
animations.starting_pose_notes: F1: Exact supine lying-down pose matching Knockdown F6 (240 px wide, head LEFT, feet RIGHT, grounded at Y=272).
animations.ending_pose_notes: F5: Fully recovered upright standard standing fighting guard (228 px height) matching Batch 1 Idle F1.
animations.cross_batch_transition_notes: F1 locks directly to Knockdown F6 with zero scale jump; F5 hands off cleanly to Batch 1 Standing Idle F1.

animations.gameplay_purpose: High-vulnerability guard-shatter and dizzy/stunned hold state leaving Rahul wide open to punish combos.
animations.starting_pose_notes: F1: Crossed-forearm Standing Guard shattered by overwhelming incoming impact.
animations.ending_pose_notes: F5: Holdable stunned stance — weakened bent knees, slumped shoulders, head tilted dazed, arms hanging open at sides (zero cartoon stars/effects).
animations.cross_batch_transition_notes: Enters directly from Standing Guard; holds F5 cleanly for the duration of engine stun timer before recovering to Idle F1.
